title: Haveli ka laal dibba: kaun hai chor? (Part 1)
hooks: Ek haveli. Ek raat. Aur ek laal dibba... jo ab wahan nahi hai.
Teen log. Teen bahane. Ek jhooth.
Chor ne khud apni galti bol di. Aapne suni?
hook_why: Starts mid-mystery with an object (the red box) and a loss, no greeting; the lost object is the question.
metaphor: A fair-play whodunit: the culprit slips by mentioning a detail nobody told him (the black bag); viewers who listen can solve it.

caption: Chor ne khud apni galti bol di. Aapne suni? 🕵️ Teen suspect, teen bahane, ek jhooth. Comment mein A, B ya C likho. Sahi jawab kal Part 2 mein.

claims.claim: Fiction. Inspector, haveli, and suspects are invented.

answer_for_part2: Munshi Ramlal. Only the Inspector, Thakur and the thief knew the red box was carried in a black bag; nobody had mentioned a bag before Munshi did. Clean handle: Meera (flour) and Kallu (grease) would have left marks; Munshi wore gloves of his ledger cloth. Part 2 reveals the black bag in his room.
